ledger.claim: The rider does not contest the dwell arithmetic, and this brief puts no weight on it. The driver's own trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 507 seconds from 06:41:10 to the cancellation at 06:49:37, against a free waiting period in force of 300 seconds on this STANDARD-class pickup, so the derived shortfall figure of minus 207 seconds is a surplus, not a deficit, and POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not this case's route. The rider's case is the separate question POL-NS-07 and POL-NS-09 decide, namely whether this driver may take money out of the fee at all.

The driver's own profile meets both limbs of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on the platform's numbers: 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 61 completed trips in the same window, which is 11.5 per cent - above the 8 per cent rate limb and well above the absolute limb of 4. These are the only two profile fields POL-NS-07 reads, and they are cited here for that test alone, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

Even taking the driver's account at its highest, with POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, that tripped check means his 80 per cent compensation is withheld outright and the case is escalated under POL-NS-09, limb (d) making a tripped anti-farming check a mandatory escalation. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal for the automated pipeline: no monetary ruling issues, the 4.00 cancellation fee is held rather than collected or refunded, and the escalation packet must carry a direction to the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full. That escalation, with the refund direction inside it, is the ruling the rider asks this tribunal to record; NO_ACTION is not the rider's claim, because on a rider-filed dispute it would leave the charge standing under POL-GEN-03.

The 4.00 is not yet in the platform's hands: the fare record shows a 4.00 cancellation-fee line with payment_status PENDING, total_charged 4.50 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. Holding that state while the anti-farming pattern is reviewed is the outcome that keeps the rider from funding a charge the platform has not resolved, which is the express purpose POL-NS-07 gives the hold.

Every abuse trigger POL-NS-09 can read on the rider points the other way. The rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb (d) requires, and rider and driver each show 0 disputes with the other in the last 90 days under limb (c). The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure is a different counter from no_show_disputes_30d, and POL-GEN-01 forbids reading the lifetime counter in the clause's place, so nothing in the rider's citable profile supports an adverse finding or a refusal of this escalation.

ledger.claim: The contested amount is 4.00, below the 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05, so on any ruling that lets the fee stand the charge is executed automatically without a human reading this file. The POL-NS-07 hold, carried into a POL-NS-09 escalation, is the only mechanism on this record that stops a 4.00 fee being collected from the rider while the driver's 7 no-show terminations in 30 days are examined.

Limb (a) of the baseline no-show test is met on the face of the record: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 06:41:20, and the trip was never boarded and was terminated by the driver rather than completed.

Limb (b) is met: the GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius on 52 qualifying fixes, the first of them at 06:41:10 - ten seconds before the 06:41:20 arrival event - so the arrival geofence test of POL-NS-02 is satisfied on admissible, in-radius readings rather than on a single stray fix at the edge.

Limb (c) is met with 207 seconds to spare: the driver's own trace shows a single unbroken in-geofence dwell of 507 seconds, running from 06:41:10 to 06:49:37, against the free waiting period of 300 seconds in force for this STANDARD-zone trip. The run count is 1, so no accumulation across separate intervals is needed and POL-NS-06(i) is not in play.

Limb (d) is met: the trip record shows the driver terminated the trip at 06:49:37 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - at or after the moment the required 300-second dwell had elapsed, since the dwell ran the full 507 seconds - and no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip.

The arrival marker is not false and POL-NS-05 does not displace the waiting clock: the qualifying in-geofence run opens at 06:41:10, ten seconds BEFORE the 06:41:20 arrival event, so the driver was already inside the radius holding position when he marked arrival. Under POL-NS-05 limb (iii), even a marker that slightly preceded the arrival would not defeat a fee whose corrected dwell meets the minimum, and here there is nothing to correct.

This is not a wrong-entrance case and POL-NS-03 decides nothing: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m arrival radius - his closest recorded approach to the pickup pin is 14.5 m - and not in the 50 m to 400 m band that POL-NS-03 governs, so POL-NS-03 yields to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-01.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (a) requires a rider message that is locating or coordinating, and the chat log holds four messages - one from SYSTEM and three from the driver - with nothing at all from the rider, so the rider-contact route never opens. The driver separately placed an in-app call at 06:45:10 that went unanswered, which defeats the clause even where the chat shows nothing.

The rider's own device track is present and affirmatively places it roughly 1.9 km from the pickup point for the whole waiting window - 118 fixes, minimum recorded distance 1894 m, and zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is therefore failed on admissible evidence, not merely undecidable, and the rider's assertion that he 'did come down' is contradicted by his own GPS.

The rider never cancelled, so the grace provisions of POL-NS-10(a) to (c) cannot be reached on these facts: the trip record shows cancelled_by DRIVER at 06:49:37, some seventeen minutes after acceptance at 06:32:50. No limb of POL-NS-10 returns a driver-terminated no-show charge to the rider.

No traffic advisory covers Woodlands Ave 6 in this window: EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, so it can carry no fact either way. That costs the driver nothing, because the 507-second dwell is a single unbroken in-geofence run and POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not required to clear the 300-second minimum.

ledger.claim: On the merits the fee is chargeable and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force for this trip - SGD 3.20, the net figure the fare arithmetic itself returns and the figure the trip record's platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00 supports.

I do not conceal the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check, and on this driver's own record both its limbs are met: 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 61 completed trips, a rate of about 11.5 percent, above the 8 percent threshold. Compensation is therefore withheld and the case routes to human review under POL-NS-09(d) - a portfolio-level risk signal, not a finding about this trip. Because escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal and holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it, the fee stands held and the rider's claim to the SGD 4.00 does not succeed on this record.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The arrival and waiting facts favour the driver, but the driver's own profile sends the case to human review, so nothing is collected or refunded today.

RIDER — on the merits your refund claim does not succeed. EV-GPS-00207 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius at Blk 682 from 06:41:10 to the cancellation at 06:49:37: one unbroken in-geofence dwell of 507 seconds against the free waiting period of 300 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a surplus of 207 seconds against EV-GPS-00207.derived.arrival.shortfall_sec of -207. His 06:41:20 arrival tap came ten seconds after he was already in the radius, and he was stationary (speed 0.0 kph), so POL-NS-05 finds no false arrival marker; no boarding event is recorded and he terminated under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. Your statement that you 'did come down' is not supported: the rider_track in EV-GPS-00207 holds 118 fixes, none inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, the closest 1894 m from the pin, for the whole waiting window. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you — you sent no chat message (EV-CHAT-00207 holds one SYSTEM and three DRIVER entries) and the driver's 06:45:10 in-app call went unanswered. POL-NS-06 gives you nothing (507 s against the 300 s minimum) and POL-NS-10 does not apply (you did not cancel). POL-NS-03 does not apply either: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius (closest approach 14.5 m), not in the 50–400 m wrong-entrance band. POL-NS-01 is therefore satisfied on all four limbs and the SGD 4.00 fee would be chargeable.

DRIVER — what takes the case off the ordinary charge/refund route is your own record. Both limbs of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check are met on the platform's numbers: EV-DPROF-00207 shows no_show_terminations_30d of 7 (the limb requires 4 or more) and 7 divided by 61 completed trips in the same 30 days is 11.5%, above the 8% rate limb. Under POL-NS-07 your compensation — 80% of the SGD 4.00 fee in force, SGD 3.20 (EV-FARE-00207.derived.money.driver_compensation) — is WITHHELD, and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues, and the disputed SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is held rather than collected or refunded. The fare record shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.50, payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and that state is preserved.

Open question for the human reviewer: whether the driver's 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days reflect genuine rider no-shows or fee-farming. Per POL-NS-07 the escalation packet must direct the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 in full if the pattern is not explained (see referrals).

The POL-NS-09 abuse triggers on the rider do not fire: EV-RPROF-00207.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (limb (d) needs 3 or more) and both parties show 0 disputes with the other in the last 90 days (limb (c)). The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags is a different counter and may not be read in place of no_show_disputes_30d.

Confidence 0.95. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact is at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-00207, EV-TRIP-00207, EV-DPROF-00207, EV-FARE-00207), so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no deciding fact here: the 507-second dwell is a single run, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not required and the fee does not depend on it. Both the SGD 4.00 fee and the SGD 3.20 compensation are below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, but escalation holds them regardless.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-07: the escalation packet must direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full — the driver's 80% compensation (SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 fee) is withheld under the anti-farming check (7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 61 completed trips, 11.5%).
